description: This file contains the implementation of the BestSeller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines a controller that handles the display of best-selling products on a module page, including loading dependencies, fetching product data, processing images, calculating prices and taxes, and rendering the view template.

classes.name: BestSeller
classes.description: Controller class for handling the Bestseller module in the OpenCart catalog extension, extending the core Controller class to implement functionality for listing top-selling products.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method for rendering the bestseller module; loads language, models, fetches bestsellers, processes product data, and returns the view HTML.
